title: Nvidia Stock Is Crashing: Did I Buy More? | NVDA Stock Analysis
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; note: captions garble some names and figures in places
summary: Parkevtate reacts to Nvidia's worst week on record: shares fell as much as 14% in a day after Reuters reported an SEC probe into potential accounting issues, with the Wall Street Journal reporting the probe covers whether disclosures misled investors. Since 6 October Nvidia has lost over $2.5 trillion in market value, the worst 45-day loss for any stock. He walks through the issues: about $104 billion of 2025 sales booked through its Singapore unit, roughly half of sales, with questions over whether chips were rerouted to China via Singapore-based Megaspeed despite export controls; a delayed 10-Q and an independent board-committee investigation; and circular-financing arrangements, explained as a ladder of sale quality from clean cash sales down to equity investments made with the understanding the recipient buys Nvidia product. He expects at worst a multi-billion-dollar fine and business as usual, arguing the administration is overcompensating after criticism over its handling of the former CEO's alleged links to a Chinese spy. He added to his Nvidia position in the sell-off and reiterates it as a top-10 buy. Note: captions garble the fair-value figure; his last stated DCF fair value was $259 (21 Nov). Call: NVDA BUY reiterated at ~$125.

calls.thesis: BUY reiterated (was BUY 21 Nov @ ~$150, FV $259). Added more to his position today after the sell-off on Reuters reports of an SEC probe into Nvidia's accounting and Singapore chip-rerouting, plus a delayed 10-Q and circular-financing scrutiny. Reiterates top-10 ranking; FV not reliably captured from captions (garbled).
calls.base_case: Probe ends in at worst a multi-billion fine ('slap on the wrist'); business as usual, circular-financing issues already known.
calls.bull_case: Probe resolves as a fine, headlines fade, and the AI demand story reasserts itself.
calls.bear_case: Stricter export enforcement outside the US, or a restatement from the delayed 10-Q investigation.
